text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You want to know more about Air<n>Shakur? But then
why are you asking<n>me?

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Surely you've heard about my<n>session with her...
She and I couldn't<n>see eye to eye. Heck, we barely
spoke. I won't be much help.
choice_data_list:
Then do you have any insight into why you didn't
get along?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After our last encounter, it doesn't<n>seem wise to
ask Air Shakur about<n>herself directly. So instead, I
decide to<n>ask others about their impressions of<n>her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I need to know more about her—her<n>achievements,
her path up until now...<n>everything. The more I learn
about<n>her, the more I'll understand.
choice_data_list: Please, anything you can tell me would help!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hm...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you there. I emailed you just<n>now, so be sure
to check your inbox.<n>Bye now.
choice_data_list: W-wait a minute!
W-wait a minute!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In my inbox, I find Agnes Tachyon's<n>email... and the
files attached to it.<n>Every single one looks like a
complex<n>research paper...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
All of those were received from<n>Shakur as part of a
trade between<n>researchers. Her graphs and
formula<n>layouts should reveal something<n>about her
inner workings.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As should her blunt writing devoid of<n>any flowery
modifiers. While I<n>personally see commitment to
aesthetics in her work...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
According to her, she's doing no<n>such thing. I'm
not sure I believe<n>that... Ah, I suppose those papers
may be a tad difficult to comprehend.
choice_data_list: Sure, but I'll still read them. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Well, I won't explain themeither, so do your best. As long asyou do that, something is bound to happen. I'm sure of it.
choice_data_list: Why are you helping me?
Why are you helping me?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Helping" you certainly was not my<n>intention. But as
a researcher... I do<n>not want anything to impede
progress. Yours or hers.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
So begins my days of collecting<n>information on Air
Shakur. I watch<n>countless recordings and inquire
with<n>other trainers and her classmates<n>alike. Until...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I better find a trainer soon. Why did a<n>trainer have
to be one of the<n>conditions to debut... Guess it's a
bit<n>late to object.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: A trainer, huh...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: "You still want to win though, right?"

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: "You still want to win though, right?"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(No matter who I pick, they're going<n>to be a pain. In
that case, anyone's<n>fine... Not like they'll do much
anyway.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(That said... The thought of seeing<n>their confused
face every day makes<n>my skin crawl. And what's
the point<n>of debuting... if I already know what<n>will
happen?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe I should just give up.
choice_data_list: Do you mean that?
Do you mean that?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Not like it would be that weird tosay. Maybe now's just the time toquit.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I mean, who the hell wants to play a<n>game they
already know the ending<n>to? Morons, that's who.
choice_data_list: And you're no moron.
And you're no moron.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...You're right. So—
choice_data_list: But you won't give up. Because you want to win.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After retracing her steps through<n>reports and
recordings, I've come to<n>know a fraction of the
effort she's<n>put into winning the Derby. So I know
for a fact...
choice_data_list: You won't give up. Ever.
You won't give up. Ever.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I hate when people talk to me like<n>that. You don't
know me, so quit<n>acting like it.
choice_data_list: You're right. I don't know you...
You're right. I don't know you...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I try, I may never<n>catch even a
glimpse of her world...<n>but that won't stop me from
trying.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
If she'll let me, I'm sure we can<n>work together to
achieve her goal.<n>Even if we aren't alike, our eyes
can<n>still settle on the same horizon.
choice_data_list:
But I don't want to give up on trying to understand
you either.

But I don't want to give up on trying to understand
you either.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
How the... You can't even write code.<n>And you
base your actions on<n>ambiguous things like
dreams. We're<n>nothing alike.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You really think... you can understandme? How could you? And even if youcould... What good would it do?
choice_data_list: In order to figure that out, I'll need your help.
In order to figure that out, I'll need your help.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And what if... it all amounts to<n>nothing? Are you
really—
choice_data_list: Yes! I want to be your trainer!
Yes! I want to be your trainer!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I seriously don't get you. Training<n>me wouldn't
benefit you in any way.
choice_data_list: Of course it would.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah? How?
choice_data_list: I get to see you win!
I get to see you win!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I want to see the moment her hardwork—her obsession pays off. As atrainer, there could be no greaterreward than that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I knew it, you don't understand a<n>word I'm
saying... Not really seeing<n>the benefit for me either
at this point.
choice_data_list: Well, you get to debut, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...I won't need to debut if I quit, right?
choice_data_list: Well, I'll be around if you decide to stick with it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: The hell was up with that?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
"But I don't want to give up on trying<n>to understand
you either."

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
"But I don't want to give up on trying<n>to understand
you either."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Shut up. Piss off. Even if you could<n>get me... what
good would your<n>stubborn ass do anyways?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Although... I suppose persistence is<n>the one thing
we have in common.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I've yet to find a way to breach<n>those seven
centimeters. Nothing's<n>changed since I first
calculated my<n>chances. But...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Giving up... just doesn't feel right.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That night, I spot Air Shakur as I'm<n>out and about.
Worried, I decide to<n>watch over her from a distance
until<n>she returns to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Police Officer
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, you've been following<n>that girl for a
while now. Care to tell<n>me why?

text_block_list.name: Police Officer
text_block_list.text:
We've received reports of someone<n>stalking
Umamusume at night.<n>Perhaps you could tell me
what you<n>know about that at the station?
choice_data_list: W-wait, I don't—
W-wait, I don't—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Heh... Guess I have no choice.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, leave 'em alone. Can't you see<n>they're
scared? Besides...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: That "stalker" is my trainer... Isn't that<n>right?
